items.stem: Four 4 TB disks in RAID 5 give how much usable space?
How many disk failures does RAID 6 survive guaranteed?
What does RAID 0 offer and risk?
choices: Full capacity and speed; any failure loses all

items.stem: Why is RAID 10's guaranteed tolerance listed as one failure?
choices: A second failure in the same mirror pair loses data

items.stem: Why is RAID not a backup?
choices: Deletion and ransomware hit every disk at once

items.stem: Why prefer RAID 6 over RAID 5 with large disks?
choices: Long rebuilds stress survivors; a second failure is survivable
